err_select_tool_first: Select a tool on the left before choosing a slot.
err_material_mismatch: Material mismatch: tool {tool} requires {toolMaterial}, but slot {slot} contains {slotMaterial}.
err_slot_taken: Slot {slot} is already assigned to tool {tool}.
warn_color: Tool {tool} was sliced for {toolColor} but slot {slot} holds {slotColor}. The print will start; its colors will differ.
no_printer: No printer configured. Edit this card and pick a FlashForge printer.
no_files: The printer reports no files. Send one from your slicer first.
warn_no_station: This file was sliced for a Material Station, but the printer is not reporting one. It will print with whatever is loaded.
mapping_hint: Select a tool, then the slot it should print from.
